methodChange: The contract now prevents incidental approved-reference context and one-candidate cross-output inference from becoming acceptance checks after v7 produced both contract overreach and inconsistent shared-invariant verdicts.

frozenFacts.use: Its embedded source facts are the frozen controller-supplied project contract; the unavailable external originals were not reread.

authorityContract.scope: Derive an implementation-independent Design-to-Visual acceptance contract for the named Collection modal and its Default and Pixel variants from the approved image and frozen facts. This does not independently prove the surrounding gameplay background, external source files, current package, runtime, interaction, or user acceptance.
authorityContract.contextRule: Pixels outside the named Collection modal may be recorded as incidental context but cannot become acceptance requirements without a separate frozen source.
authorityContract.comparisonRule: Shared properties must be candidate-local checks applied independently to each named variant or state. This schema supplies no paired-output evidence scope, so cross-output comparison checks are forbidden.

requiredOutput.applicabilityRule: Include only dimensions required by the check. Every dimension value is a non-empty array of exact authority names. Section placement never supplies applicability. Every visible-appearance acceptance check must name the Collection modal surface.
requiredOutput.semanticsRule: Use acceptance for product requirements and boundary for evidence limitations. Every check is atomic to one evidence layer; split cross-layer expectations and use stable unique ids.
requiredOutput.contentRule: Every check cites sourceIds and one candidate-local observableFact. Do not include candidate coordinates, predicted verdicts, surrounding-background requirements, or cross-output comparisons. Preserve unavailable-source and unverified-layer limits without turning them into acceptance requirements.
